documents.title: Project README
documents.description: What CypherMiner is, why it exists, the tech (Vite + TS, no framework, PWA), the registry architecture, dev/build commands, the full tool list per category, and its place in the QI ecosystem (ports 8502/7842).

documents.title: Claude Project Instructions
documents.description: Session-start protocol, what CypherMiner is, paths, ports (do-not-change rule), and the parallel-projects table so structural changes never break siblings.

documents.title: Requirements
documents.description: Python backend deps: fastapi, uvicorn[standard], gradio, httpx, python-dotenv, python-docx, pydantic. (The frontend has its own package.json.)

documents.title: Start script
documents.description: Dev convenience launcher: runs main.py (API :8502 + placeholder UI). Prints the API/UI URLs.

documents.title: Business Documentation
documents.description: Business-facing documents for CypherMiner (positioning, value).

documents.title: Technical Documentation
documents.description: Technical reference documents for the suite and its architecture.

documents.title: User Documentation
documents.description: End-user guides for using the tools.

documents.title: Cheatsheets
documents.description: Quick-reference cheatsheets for the cipher / encoding / math / text tools.

documents.title: Implementation Log
documents.description: Chronological build history — what was created, fixed and decided.

documents.title: Meeting Minutes
documents.description: Session-by-session decisions and next steps.

documents.title: Session Summaries
documents.description: Dated session summaries for the project.

documents.title: Summary generator
documents.description: Generates a Word (.docx) project summary via python-docx.

documents.title: Tool contract (types)
documents.description: Lang/Loc/CategoryId, the ToolInput union, and the Tool + Category interfaces. The single contract every tool implements.

documents.title: Tool registry
documents.description: register / allTools / toolsByCategory / getTool / allCategories — the in-memory registry that self-registering tool modules push into.

documents.title: UI shell
documents.description: Framework-free UI shell + hash router: header, sidebar (search/pin/favorites), hero/category/tool views, the live tool runner, and the assistant dock.

documents.title: i18n
documents.description: Bilingual UI strings (Loc pairs) + getLang/setLang/loc/t. Language persisted to localStorage.

documents.title: Theme / Favorites / Config
documents.description: Dark/light theming, localStorage favourites, and the runtime config.json loader (assistantMode, cloudEndpoint, lotteryWizUrl, showAllTools).

documents.title: Content store
documents.description: ToolDoc shape + setDocs/getDoc — the educational metadata (How it works / history / trivia / source) keyed by tool id.

documents.title: App bootstrap
documents.description: Imports styles, the UI shell, all tools (self-register) and all content, loads config, then mounts into #app.

documents.title: Tool registration index
documents.description: Imports all 59 tool modules so they self-register (19 crypto, 13 encoding, 14 math, 2 lottery, 11 text).

documents.title: Tool modules
documents.description: One file per tool. e.g. crypto/caesar.ts (+ cipher wheel), crypto/autosolve.ts, math/factor.ts (BigInt factorization), text/slugify.ts, encoding/base64.ts, lottery/odds.ts.

documents.title: Educational content
documents.file: crypto.ts, encoding.ts, math.ts, lottery.ts, text.ts, index.ts
documents.description: Bilingual explanation/history/trivia/source for tools, registered via setDocs(); kept separate from tool logic.

documents.title: Shared visual builders
documents.description: mappingStrip / grid5 / railZigzag — reusable HTML/SVG generators used by crypto tool visuals.

documents.title: Assistant
documents.description: On-device TF-IDF retrieval (local.ts), the optional hosted provider (cloud.ts), the selector (index.ts) and the shared provider contract (types.ts).

documents.title: FastAPI app
documents.description: CypherMiner API v0.1.0 on :8502 — /health, /version, /info (QI module contract). CORS from the QI registry with a localhost fallback. Reserved for future heavy/data tools.

documents.title: API entry point
documents.description: uvicorn api.main:app on 127.0.0.1:8502 — the entry used by the QI_CypherMinerAPI service.

documents.title: Dual launcher
documents.description: Dev launcher: API thread + placeholder Gradio UI; UTF-8 stdout; logs to data/logs/cypherminer.log.

documents.title: Config loader
documents.description: Caches config/cypherminer.json and loads secrets/cypherminer.env (dotenv). Dotted-path get().

documents.title: Runtime config
documents.description: App name/version, server ports (api 8502, ui 7842, host 127.0.0.1), logging level + dir.

documents.title: Secrets template
documents.description: Template for secrets; the real .env is git-ignored.

documents.title: Placeholder UI (unused)
documents.description: Legacy Gradio scaffold on :7843 — NOT the real UI; the static Vite build on :7842 is the product.

documents.title: Frontend package
documents.description: Vite scripts (dev/build/preview) + devDeps: typescript 5.6, vite 6, vite-plugin-pwa 0.21. No runtime UI framework.

documents.title: Vite & TS config
documents.description: Build + PWA config and the TypeScript compiler settings.

documents.title: HTML entry
documents.description: Minimal shell: <div id="app"> + module script src=/src/main.ts; meta description + icon.

documents.title: API service installer
documents.description: Installs the QI_CypherMinerAPI NSSM service (run_api.py, :8502, auto-start).

documents.title: Tunnel installer
documents.description: Installs QI_CypherMinerTunnel. On the QI box it runs the static named tunnel qi-cypherminer -> https://cypher.quiddityinnovations.com; on customer boxes a legacy quick tunnel.

documents.title: Service setup script
documents.description: Idempotent installer (run elevated) for QI_CypherMinerUI (static http.server on :7842) and related services. Plus diag.ps1 / diag2.ps1 diagnostics.

documents.title: Smoke tests
documents.description: pytest checks of /health, /version, /info, /openapi.json; SKIPS (never fails) if the API is down — CI/offline-safe.

documents.title: QI Ecosystem Registry (cypherminer)
documents.description: CypherMiner entry: ports api 8502 (block 8500-8599) / ui 7842 (block 7840-7849), status 'complete', family_tier 'sibling', exposes /health /version /info.

documents.title: QI Service Registry (CypherMiner services)
documents.description: Canonical NSSM entries: QI_CypherMinerUI (static :7842), QI_CypherMinerTunnel (named tunnel qi-cypherminer -> cypher.quiddityinnovations.com), and the API service.

documents.description: Where CypherMiner sits in the QI port/family map and integration contracts.
